# Psychological Safety Index - 心理安全指数追踪
# 基于Google Aristotle项目、Amy Edmondson研究

cultural_metrics:
  # 心理安全指数 (Psychological Safety Index)
  psi:
    name: "Psychological Safety Index"
    description: "团队成员无惧表达真实想法的程度"
    scale: "0-100"
    target: ">= 80"
    
    dimensions:
      - name: "发言安全"
        weight: 0.25
        indicators:
          - "敢于提出不同意见"
          - "不怕被嘲笑"
          - "愿意分享失败经验"
          
      - name: "犯错包容"
        weight: 0.25
        indicators:
          - "错误被当作学习
